posting_windows.sample: brief posts with a complete impressions snapshot
posting_windows.signals: reach (impressions, all measured briefs) and engagement rate (engagements / impressions, briefs with above-median reach only), each hour vs the rest of the day, Mann-Whitney + Cliff's delta, Holm-corrected across all hour x signal contrasts
posting_windows.instruction: When assigning posting_time, prefer recommended_hours and never use avoid_hours, but keep the day's usual shape: the same number of posts, spread across the day, at least 20 minutes apart, no more than 2 posts in any one hour, and within the caps of 5 posts 6AM-noon, 4 posts noon-6PM, 3 posts 6PM-midnight CT. Hours without a verdict are neutral. If recommended_hours is empty, keep the current schedule.
posting_windows.note: No hour cleared the Holm-corrected significance gates against the rest of the day; keep the current schedule.

methodology.test: Mann-Whitney U (two-sided, tie-corrected, normal approximation with continuity correction)
methodology.rationale: Impression counts are heavily right-skewed; rank-based tests are robust to that shape. Cliff's delta floor of 0.20 excludes tiny-but-significant differences that aren't practically actionable.

top_performers.text:
In case you missed Cubs news today:

> 🚫 Don't hold your breath on a Bryce Harper or Ronald Acuña Jr. blockbuster
   - Cubs insiders don't expect Chicago to land either star
   - The likelier path: shorter deals for veteran bats to help replace Seiya Suzuki
   - Harper is signed through 2031 on his 13-year, $330M deal

> 💰 Don't expect a Dodgers- or Mets-style spending spree, either
   - The Cubs have never gone past Jason Heyward's $184M deal, and that history hangs over any Tarik Skubal chase

> 🔄 The trade market could be where the Cubs find an arm
   - Seattle, Miami, Tampa Bay and Minnesota have been floated as trade partners, with Joe Ryan and Drew Rasmussen among the names
   - Rasmussen went 16-5 with a 2.67 ERA and 174 strikeouts in 2026
   - The Rays picked up his $20M option for 2027 and say they intend to keep him for now

> 🛡️ Bullpen help may come with a draft-pick cost
   - Padres lefty Adrián Morejón is one of eight free agents who got a qualifying offer
   - A team over the luxury tax that signs a QO player loses its second- and fifth-highest picks plus $1M in international bonus pool money

> ❓ 40-man questions for Kevin Alcantara and Jordan Wicks
   - Alcantara has played just 34 MLB games over the last two seasons
   - Wicks made four appearances in 2026 with a 10.45 ERA

> 🌵 Kade Snell repped the Cubs in tonight's Arizona Fall League Fall Stars Game

> 🐯 Former Cub Shota Imanaga is being floated as a Tigers rotation target
   - He's projected for around two years and $40M

> 📅 Hot stove calendar
   - GM Meetings start Tuesday in Las Vegas
   - NL MVP is announced Thursday, and Pete Crow-Armstrong is a finalist
   - Nov. 17: Suzuki's qualifying offer deadline and Silver Slugger winners
   - The CBA expires Dec. 1

One of these every night. Follow for the daily Cubs recap.

#Cubs

In case you missed Cubs news today:

> 🚫 The Cubs won't be in the Tarik Skubal bidding war
   - They're expected to be very active on the rotation, just not at the top of the market
   - Michael King and Adrian Morejon could also end up pricier than the Cubs are comfortable with
   - Look for ground-ball and strikeout arms to pair with that elite infield defense

> 🇯🇵 Kaima Taira is a name to watch
   - The Cubs have done a lot of homework on the posted Seibu righty
   - 1.36 ERA over 146 innings in 2026, and they'd want him as a starter

> ⚠️ Ben Brown's 2027 is up in the air
   - Still not cleared to throw after the neck stress reaction that ended his season in June
   - Surgery hasn't been ruled out, and a lockout would cut him off from team trainers

> 🧩 That rotation needs a lot of rebuilding
   - Boyd, Holmes, Gausman, Imanaga, Peterson and Rea are all free agents
   - Steele hasn't pitched since April 2025, and Horton is still recovering from Tommy John

> 🇹🇼 Taiwanese closer Jyun-Yue Tseng is officially posted
   - He's been linked to the Cubs and can sign through Dec. 22
   - 25 saves in 48 games for Fubon this year

> 👋 Former Cub Antoine Kelly signed a minor league deal with Cleveland
   - The lefty threw 1 1/3 scoreless innings against the Yankees in his MLB debut with the Cubs this year

> 📋 Baseball America's new Cubs top 10 is out
   - Josiah Hartshorn, Owen Ayers and Kane Kepley are the top three
   - First-rounder Cade Townsend is the top pitching prospect

> 🏆 Rookies of the Year
   - NL: Reds 1B Sal Stewart (.263, 32 HR, 112 RBI in all 162 games)
   - AL: Tigers SS Kevin McGonigle

> 📅 Hot stove calendar
   - GM Meetings run Tuesday through Thursday in Las Vegas
   - Manager of the Year is Tuesday, and Pat Murphy is going for a third straight NL win
   - Cy Young is Wednesday
   - NL MVP is Thursday, and Pete Crow-Armstrong is a finalist

One of these every night. Follow for the daily Cubs recap.

#Cubs

In case you missed Cubs news today:

> ✈️ The Padres reportedly hosted Seiya Suzuki for a visit Monday and could be the favorites to sign him
   - Signing Suzuki could let San Diego move Fernando Tatis Jr. back to the infield full-time
   - Suzuki declined the Cubs' qualifying offer Tuesday, so the Cubs would get draft-pick compensation if he signs elsewhere

> 🔄 A Mariners pitching trade path the Cubs had been linked to just closed
   - Seattle sent starters Bryce Miller and Logan Evans plus reliever Jose A. Ferrer to the Royals in a six-player deal for Maikel Garcia, James McArthur and L.P. Langevin
   - Mariners president Jerry Dipoto said there is "zero" chance he trades another starter
   - Matt Shaw had been floated as a possible piece in a Cubs-Mariners pitching deal

> 🧤 Catcher Nick Fortes, who had been linked to the Cubs, was traded from the Rays to the Red Sox for minor league right-hander Angel Roa

> ⚾ Around MLB: Sonny Gray signed a two-year deal with the Twins, reportedly worth $55 million with an opt-out after 2027

> 📅 What's next for the Cubs
   - Friday (Nov. 20) is MLB's non-tender deadline
   - The CBA expires Dec. 1, with a lockout expected

One of these every night. Follow for the daily Cubs recap.

#Cubs

In case you missed Cubs news today:

> 💎 Pete Crow-Armstrong wins the NL Platinum Glove
   - Named the best defender in the National League at any position, his first Platinum Glove
   - First Cub to win it since Anthony Rizzo in 2016, and the first NL center fielder ever to take it
   - Led the majors with +26 Outs Above Average
   - Former Cub Cody Bellinger won it in the AL

> 🧤 The Cubs also win the NL Gold Glove Team Award
   - Best defensive team in the National League for the second straight year
   - Third overall (2020, 2025, 2026), tied with the Blue Jays for the most
   - MLB-best +72 Outs Above Average, +115 Defensive Runs Saved and a .990 fielding percentage

> 🏆 PCA isn't done collecting hardware
   - NL MVP is announced Nov. 12, and he's a finalist
   - Silver Slugger winners Nov. 17: PCA, Seiya Suzuki and Alex Bregman are finalists, and the Cubs are up for Offensive Team of the Year

> 💰 The Tarik Skubal market is taking shape
   - The Dodgers and Mets are seen as the top suitors, with the Cubs expected to at least be involved
   - His price is expected to land well above $300M; the biggest contract in Cubs history is still Jason Heyward's $184M

> 🌟 Kade Snell plays in the Arizona Fall League Fall Stars Game
   - Sunday, 8 PM ET on MLB Network

> 📅 Hot stove calendar
   - GM Meetings Nov. 10-12 in Las Vegas
   - Suzuki's deadline on his $23.15M qualifying offer is Nov. 17
   - The CBA expires Dec. 1, and a lockout would freeze free agency

> ⚾ Around MLB
   - The Nationals extended CF Jacob Young: four years, $23M
   - Max Scherzer plans to pitch in "lockout games" this winter to decide whether he'll play in 2027

One of these every night. Follow for the daily Cubs recap.

#Cubs

In case you missed Cubs news today:

> ⚾ The Cubs have reportedly shown early interest in free-agent LHP Trevor Rogers
   - Rogers, who turned 29 today, had a 4.03 ERA in 30 starts and 169 2/3 innings for the Orioles in 2026
   - He finished strong with a 2.86 ERA over his final 17 starts
   - He had a 1.81 ERA in 18 starts in 2025
   - The Orioles gave him a qualifying offer, so signing him would cost the Cubs draft picks

> 🧢 GM Carter Hawkins praised Pedro Ramirez's athleticism and work ethic as the Cubs weigh two open outfield spots
   - Matt Shaw and Kevin Alcantara are the other in-house options
   - Ramirez, 22, hit .261/.321/.402 with 6 HR and 9 SB in 266 PA in 2026

> 🎯 Hawkins said bringing back free-agent C Carson Kelly is possible, but the Cubs are comfortable with internal options at catcher

> 📝 Jed Hoyer's extension is reportedly a five-year deal, likely keeping him in charge through 2030

> 💻 The Cubs reportedly hired Rylan Domingues as a pitching analytics coordinator
   - He spent the last three seasons as a pitching development analyst with the Phillies

> 🐯 The Tigers are showing interest in former Cub Shota Imanaga
   - Imanaga, 33, had a 3.77 ERA with 174 strikeouts in 174 1/3 innings over 32 starts in 2026

> ✍️ Jake Bauers agreed to a four-year, $58 million deal with the Red Sox
   - He hit .266/.389/.484 with 26 HR for the World Series champion Brewers
   - His .389 OBP was second in the NL
   - Milwaukee gets a compensatory pick after the first round

One of these every night. Follow for the daily Cubs recap.

#Cubs
